payload.summary: No tablet viewport exists anywhere in the Playwright matrix, so the known tablet breakages cannot regress-test
payload.detail: Add one tablet Chromium project (e.g. 820x1180) covering the existing production journeys. Why: playwright.config.ts has chromium, chromium-mockups, chromium-caring-contacts-seeded, firefox, webkit, mobile-webkit and mobile-pwa-standalone — and nothing between phone and desktop, so every tablet defect is found by hand and none of them can be pinned once fixed. Context: the structural gap behind #6GR6B8 and #EKB6XR, verified by grep (zero matches for 'tablet' in playwright.config.ts). Owner: assistant. Confidence: high. Depends on: #6GR6B8, #EKB6XR.
